title: Photorealistic cinematic vertical selfie
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic vertical selfie portrait of a young adult woman in her early twenties, approximately 20 years old, with an East Asian appearance, posing confidently in an elegant, softly illuminated vintage-inspired room. Captured from a high-angle, arm's-length smartphone perspective, looking downward toward her face and upper body, with subtle wide-angle perspective distortion and an intimate, playful social-media photography aesthetic.

She has a delicate oval-to-heart-shaped face, softly rounded cheeks, a petite tapered chin, a refined jawline, a small straight nose, and naturally full rosy-pink lips forming a gentle, subtly flirtatious smile. Her large, expressive dark brown eyes feature delicate eyeliner, long defined eyelashes, subtle pink-toned eyeshadow, and bright natural catchlights. Her smooth, fair porcelain skin has soft peach undertones, luminous highlights, and realistic delicate skin texture. She looks directly into the camera with a sweet, confident, slightly mischievous expression.

Her glossy dark chocolate-brown hair is styled into a sleek, chin-to-shoulder-length bob with gently inward-curving ends and straight, wispy bangs covering her forehead. She wears delicate, minimalist, oval-shaped rimless glasses with thin black metal bridge and temples. Her left hand is raised beside her face, gently pinching the glasses near the temple, with relaxed, elegantly curved fingers.

She has a slender, naturally curvaceous figure, a defined waist, graceful shoulders, and balanced feminine proportions. She wears a fitted, dark emerald-green velvet cheongsam-inspired mini dress adorned with intricate pink, peach, and ivory floral patterns. The dress features a traditional high Mandarin collar with decorative dark-green fabric closures, an extremely deep keyhole-style front opening exposing substantial cleavage, and narrow green shoulder straps. Delicate strands of white pearls drape decoratively across her upper chest, neckline, and bare upper arms. A teal-blue lace-trimmed undergarment is visibly layered beneath the plunging neckline. The fitted dress accentuates her waist and hips, with a high side opening revealing her upper thigh and the upper edge of black lace thigh-high stockings.

Her right arm extends toward the camera to hold the phone, creating a dramatic diagonal foreground perspective, while her torso tilts slightly and her shoulders remain relaxed.

Behind her stands a dark upright piano with visible ivory keys, surrounded by lush green foliage and an arrangement of vibrant pink lilies, tall yellow blossoms, and delicate white flowers. A tall window with sheer ivory curtains occupies the right background, allowing soft natural daylight to illuminate her face and velvet outfit. Pale cream walls, white flooring, and a subtle patterned rug complete the refined interior.

Soft diffused window lighting, gentle ambient fill, realistic pearl reflections, detailed velvet textures, natural skin highlights, delicate shadows, 24mm smartphone-equivalent lens, crisp facial focus, subtle background softness, warm pastel color grading, luxurious romantic atmosphere, authentic high-resolution photography, natural anatomical proportions, no illustration, no CGI, no artificial skin smoothing, 9:16.
